title: The Benchmarkpocalypse
summary: Dan Luu's article explores how software benchmarks are systematically misleading, gaming the system, and often failing to reflect real-world performance. Through multiple case studies and examples, the author demonstrates why relying on published benchmarks is dangerous and how the benchmarking ecosystem has degraded over time.
problem_solved: Exposes the fundamental problems with software performance benchmarks and why they rarely translate to real-world improvements.
why_valuable: Helps developers critically evaluate performance claims and understand the gaming, overfitting, and measurement errors that plague the benchmarking ecosystem.
